name: ION Solar
old_description: “I have been thinking about getting solar for about 4 years. While working in the yard one day last year, a young man stopped and chatted about solar panels. He set me up with one of their sales people. On the appointed day Mitch Gresalfi showed up and we talked for over 2 hours. He provided a lot of info and he answered every question I had. To this day I haven't regretted installing the panels. My electric bills stayed the same for the first few months, ($250-$300), then they started to go down. My last bill was $0. Yes they will fluctuate throughout the year, but I am very happy with my decision.”
about:
ION Solar operates from Ashland, Virginia, serving homeowners across the United States with residential solar installations. The company has over two decades of industry experience, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not provided in available sources.

The company provides a full-service, done-for-you solar installation process that covers on-site assessment, custom system design using black-on-black Tier 1 panels and MLPE microinverters, permitting, utility approvals, and final activation. ION Solar also offers battery storage solutions such as the Tesla Powerwall 3. To date, the firm has completed more than 85,000 installations nationwide and is ranked among the top five residential solar installers, with over 7,000 customer reviews averaging 4.5 stars and an A+ Better Business Bureau rating.

ION Solar’s customers are primarily residential homeowners in Virginia and other states. Testimonials reference interactions with sales representatives such as Mitch Gresalfi, Calvin Davila, Kelsey Criswell, and Jordan Henning, as well as project coordinators like Stephanie Law. The company coordinates directly with utilities including Dominion Energy to handle interconnection paperwork and approvals.

ION Solar differentiates itself through a worry-free service model that assigns a dedicated project coordinator, provides weekly check-ins, and backs installations with a 10-year workmanship guarantee alongside 25-year product and 30-year power output warranties on panels. The company emphasizes personalized design aesthetics and ongoing support via phone, email, and live chat.
